verdict.rationale: Through Browserbase, Stagehand sessions get a dashboard with real-time browser screen recording and replay, so an engineer can watch a run live. However, this depends on the Browserbase cloud runtime, and nothing in the evidence shows a human can take over control mid-run when the agent gets stuck. missing for 10: documented human takeover/interactive control of a live session, a pause-and-resume handoff between agent and human, live viewing outside Browserbase, independent hands-on corroboration.
